indexes.ix_items_target_work_asset: CREATE INDEX ix_items_target_work_asset ON operation_items (json_extract(target, '$.work_id'), CAST(json_extract(target, '$.asset_id') AS TEXT))
indexes.ix_items_target_work_record: CREATE INDEX ix_items_target_work_record ON operation_items (json_extract(target, '$.work_id'), CAST(json_extract(target, '$.record_id') AS TEXT))
indexes.ix_items_target_scope: CREATE INDEX ix_items_target_scope ON operation_items (operation_id, json_extract(target, '$.work_id'), CAST(json_extract(target, '$.asset_id') AS TEXT), CAST(json_extract(target, '$.record_id') AS TEXT), state, position, id) WHERE json_extract(target, '$.work_id') IS NULL AND CAST(json_extract(target, '$.asset_id') AS TEXT) IS NULL AND CAST(json_extract(target, '$.record_id') AS TEXT) IS NULL

indexed_plan: SEARCH operation_items USING INDEX ix_items_target_work_asset (<expr>=? AND <expr>=?)
SEARCH operation_items USING INDEX ix_items_target_work_record (<expr>=? AND <expr>=?)
SEARCH operation_items_1 USING COVERING INDEX ix_items_target_scope (operation_id=? AND <expr>=? AND <expr>=? AND <expr>=?)
lookup_rules: explicit work target precedes asset, then derivative
bare asset outside selected window continues to shadow record target
item IDs deduplicated before loading target/result JSON
historical success retained with original ranking
legacy identity-free scope and unplanned active scope retained
index_creation_rules: caller owns transaction, commit and backup
limits: Scale evidence uses SQLite RAM, not mechanical-disk latency
New query without indexes has identical results but needs preparation for bounded work
Backup/runtime/real application handled and verified separately
